strategy_roster.name: Dskyz (DAFE) AI Adaptive Regime - Beginners Version
strategy_roster.notes: The overview documents EMA trend detection with ADX confirmation but gives no numeric defaults, so 20/50 EMA and 14/25/20 ADX are explicit research fallbacks. ATR-based risk management has no documented percentage or multiplier and is not encoded.

strategy_roster.name: Mean Reversion Pro
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < sma(close,5) and close < low + 0.2 * (high - low) and close > sma(close,100)
strategy_roster.notes: Retains the documented fast/slow SMA periods and translates the 20% range level as low plus 0.2 times the current bar range. The no-position condition is supplied by the simulator; no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Last Price
strategy_roster.notes: Level 1 best bid/ask, the 400-point interval, spread, volume limits, and session windows are unavailable in the OHLCV DSL. A close above the prior two-bar high is the long-side breakout proxy, with a mirrored prior-low exit; the absolute stop remains null.

strategy_roster.name: Reco RSI Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The corpus gives RSI zones but no defaults, so RSI(14) with standard 30/70 oversold/overbought levels is a fallback. Geometric counter-position grids, volume scaling, and collective profit/loss thresholds cannot be represented; the opposite RSI zone supplies a long exit proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Directed Movement Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented RSI(14), high level 70, and low level 30 directly. The long entry is the bullish RSI cross above 70 and the opposite cross below 30 exits; no default stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: e_RP_250 Reverse Point
strategy_roster.notes: A strict new 250-bar low is the documented long reversal signal, and a new 250-bar high is the opposite reversal exit. The 15-point take-profit, 999-point stop, trailing logic, short side, and same-candle guard are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Expert Ichimoku
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((high + low) / 2,9) > sma((high + low) / 2,26) and close > (sma((high + low) / 2,9) + sma((high + low) / 2,26)) / 2 and close > sma((high + low) / 2,52)
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma((high + low) / 2,9) < sma((high + low) / 2,26) or close < sma((high + low) / 2,26)
strategy_roster.notes: The overview names Ichimoku components and supplies periods 9/26/52 but gives no explicit entry/exit rule. A current-value SMA(midpoint) proxy uses bullish Tenkan/Kijun alignment, the cloud A/B thresholds, and Kijun loss as the exit; shifted cloud, price-action filters, martingale, and default zero offsets are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Reverse
strategy_roster.notes: Retains Bollinger(20,2), RSI(14), and the documented RSI oversold/overbought levels. The long exhaustion proxy requires price below the lower band and RSI recrossing above 30; a middle-band reversion is the target proxy. Band-based protection has no percentage values, and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Butterfly Pattern
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and low <= donchian_low_prev(low,3) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: No butterfly lookback, harmonic X/A/B/C/D ratios, or target values are supplied. A bullish reversal at a prior three-bar low with an SMA(20) filter is a bounded proxy; harmonic validation, three staged targets, break-even/trailing logic, and the short side are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: 3MA Bunny Cross
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fast/slow periods are 5/20 and the reference says the signal is a crossover on closing prices. SMA(5)/SMA(20) proxies the unavailable LWMAs, with the opposite crossover as the reversal exit; no point-based protection values are documented.
